Shareholder Benchmark Capital Advisors Has Upped American Tel & Tel Co (T) Holding; Valiant Capital Management LP Cut Holding in Apple (AAPL) as Valuation Declined
May 15, 2018 - By Marie Mckinney
Benchmark Capital Advisors increased its stake in American Tel & Tel Co (T) by 44.51% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Benchmark Capital Advisors bought 14,514 shares as the company’s stock declined 10.37% with the market. The institutional investor held 47,122 shares of the telecommunications equipment company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $1.83M, up from 32,608 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Benchmark Capital Advisors who had been investing in American Tel & Tel Co for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $196.79B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.45% or $0.1441 during the last trading session, reaching $32.0459. About 19.02M shares traded. AT&T Inc. (NYSE:T) has declined 15.88% since May 15, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 27.43% the S&P500.
Christopher R. Hansen decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 86.96% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Valiant Capital Management Lp sold 2.96M shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The hedge fund run by Christopher R. Hansen held 443,400 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $75.04 million, down from 3.40M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Valiant Capital Management Lp who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $914.95B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.06% or $2 during the last trading session, reaching $186.15. About 16.92 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since May 15, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
